Experience 
 
Experienced financial professional with 5+ years experience in fund accounting and derivatives trade 
processing and reconciliation. Proficient in trade booking, trade settlements and NAV calculation. Committed 
to delivering high-quality results, resolving complex discrepancies and contributing to organizational growth 
through innovation and collabration. 
 
State Street Corporate  Services 
Fund Accounting Oct 2024 - Aug 2026 
 Manage fund accounting activities for mutual fund investment funds and pension funds, ensuring accuracy, 
timeliness, and compliance with accounting standards. 
 Perform daily, monthly, and quarterly Net Asset Value calculations, ensuring all components are correctly 
reflected prior to NAV finalization. 
 Ensure accurate NAV calculation through detailed reconciliation of trades and cash balances. 
 Actively involved in trade booking and trade settlement processes, ensuring IM trade data is accurately 
matched with custody data. 
 Record capital stock transactions, subscriptions, redemptions, dividend reinvestments, income, and 
expenses in the accounting system accurately. 
 Reconcile fund accounting books with custody records, investigating and resolving breaks as required. 
 Perform security pricing to maintain accurate market valuations for reliable NAV reporting. 
 Utilize market data sources such as Bloomberg and Refinitiv to source, validate, and review security prices 
in accordance with pricing policies. 
 Validate and clear cash breaks, ensuring alignment between accounting records, custody systems. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve trade and cash discrepancies efficiently and within SLA. 
 Review tasks and activities performed by the team to prevent internal errors and strengthen quality. 
 Provide training and development sessions to team members and new joiners, supporting knowledge 
transfer, process understanding, and performance improvement. 
 
Derivatives  Accounting  & Trade Processing Dec 2020 - Sep 2024 
 Processed manual trades from multiple sources, including SWIFT, Secure Transport, Managed File 
Transfer, fax and Interaction Management tools. 
 Handled margin, interest, fees, forex, and tax postings across various funds and accounts. 
 Managed broker conversions, as well as fund mergers and liquidations. 
 Performed Asset ID generation for newly introduced securities. 
 Coordinated with Client Delivery Management, Client Operations, Asset Management Services, and 
onshore teams to resolve trade and cash breaks. 
 Conducted security-level position reconciliations between Investment Managers (IM) and Brokers. 
 Identified discrepancies and posted required accounting entries to reconcile the Risk Management System 
and reporting data. 
 Utilized and maintained group-level macros for forex, fees, and interest postings to improve efficiency. 
 Updated and maintained control reports to prevent late postings and ensure compliance with timelines. 
 Worked on Trade Review Services to clear trade alerts raised due to price factor issues. 
 Supported internal and external audits by providing data, explanations, and required documentation. 
 Delivered refresher training to existing team members to reduce processing errors and provided 
production training to new joiners. 
 Performed bulk trade uploads for derivative transactions, reviewing trade files for 
completeness and validating required trade attributes before processing to minimize 
downstream trade breaks and processing exceptions. 
     
Associate 2 
sivasai4251@gmail.com 
  
 Pune, Maharashtra 
   
 Performed pre-upload trade validation by checking key attributes including 
fund/account, security/Asset ID, buy/sell indicator, quantity, price, trade date, settlement 
date, currency and broker/counterparty details before uploading transactions into the 
processing system. 
 Investigated and resolved STP trade breaks and processing exceptions arising from 
incorrect or incomplete trade attributes, security setup, settlement details and accounting 
information, coordinating with Client Operations, Asset Management Services, brokers 
and onshore teams for timely resolution. 
 Utilized TLM for trade lifecycle monitoring, reconciliation and exception management, 
investigating unmatched trades and processing breaks and following through with 
relevant teams until resolution. 
 Validated and maintained Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) for derivative 
trade processing, identifying missing or incorrect settlement details and coordinating 
corrections with the relevant teams to prevent settlement failures. 
 Processed derivative transactions through the trade lifecycle from receipt and 
validation through booking, settlement, reconciliation and downstream 
accounting, covering margin, interest, fees, FX and tax-related postings across multiple 
funds and accounts.

 Received client appreciation for resolving the backdated trades issue for one of the critical clients. 
 Received appreciation from onshore team for smooth broker conversion for complex IMs. 
 
 Implemented automation for trade and cash workflows to reduce manual steps and improve control 
effectiveness. 
 Running macros for Forex, interest processing and backdated margin checks to flag late instructions and 
support quality reveiws. 
 Enhance productivity tracking and control reporting to enable timely follow ups on aged breaks and 
operational issue.
